correctness.rationale: A direct row/column neighbor count proves the support classification without exceptions, and an induction on processed columns establishes the three-status recurrence. For m,n >=6 the degree-four rectangle count and degree-five impossibility follow from occupied row/column degree >=2; full 2x3 rectangles witness degree six. For m,n>=7 all degree-six supports are either 2x3,3x2,or 3x3 complements of matchings, proving the exact coefficient. The supplied direct enumerator independently tested 1,423,541 vertex subsets across 21 boards and matched the DP, with boundary checks. Finite tests supplement an all-positive-integer proof.

value.rationale: Forts are the natural obstructions to zero forcing, and counting them by cardinality refines a published extremal product theorem into an exact polynomial. The universal degree-five gap for m,n>=6 is a substantive structural reason this family is non-unimodal, with a sharp natural boundary witnessed by 120 five-forts when m=n=5. The polynomial-time arithmetic procedure is meaningful for arbitrary board dimensions and all coefficients. No general arbitrary-graph polynomial count is claimed.
